name: Semantic Extraction Fail-Safe Requires Review
sourceDocument: PROJECT-DEFINED PIPELINE-TRUST RULE — not an RBI clause
confidenceNote: This rule is not a financial-topology or regulatory rule. It is the project’s fail-safe implementation of Principle 8: when semantic extraction cannot establish even the shape of a financial fact, the release requires human review rather than silently passing.
clauseText: Not applicable — pipeline trust failure, not a quoted regulatory clause.
observableGraphCondition: No graph condition. The semantic fallback was unavailable, timed out, or returned schema-invalid output.
implementationNotes: Produces a frozen-shape PolicyViolation with policyId EXTRACTION_FAILSAFE.
Valid AI_INFERRED/UNCERTAIN evidence is not a failsafe; it remains on the normal graph and policy path.
